name: Alistair Finch
bio:
Alistair has been navigating the complex world of motorsport finance for over 25 years. His career began in auditing, but a chance encounter at a Silverstone race weekend ignited a passion for the sport. He transitioned to a smaller racing team, quickly proving his worth by streamlining their budget and securing vital sponsorships. Alistair understands that success on the track requires meticulous financial planning and resource management.

He's known for his calm demeanor under pressure and his ability to find creative solutions to financial challenges. Alistair believes in building strong relationships with his clients and team members, fostering a collaborative environment where everyone is working towards a common goal. His loyalty and dedication are unmatched, making him a valuable asset to any organization.

While Alistair's approach is generally conservative, he is open to innovative financial strategies that can provide a competitive edge. He is always looking for new ways to maximize resources and ensure the long-term financial stability of the team.

physical.hairStyle: short, neatly combed with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: Alistair is of average height with a slightly stocky build and a kind, approachable face.

quirks: Always carries a well-worn copy of 'The Intelligent Investor'.
Insists on using a fountain pen for all important documents.
Has a lucky pound coin that he uses to make budget decisions.
